fields.Participants: Green-Certified Sales Associate, Sustainability Coordinator, Trade Sales Rep
fields.Trigger: Customer inquires about green building materials

workflows.name: Green Building Project Material Consultation Service

Automation Opportunity: - Material-takeoff auto-computed from the project dimensions; quotation auto-generated from the takeoff × pricing; project-status auto-tracked from milestone completion
Controls: - CTL-464 (ensure controlled execution — Green Building Project Consultation (PA-78.2).)
- operational: Green-Certified Sales Associate sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Scope-creep risk**: the project scope expands beyond the original quotation, eroding margin; mitigated by the change-order process and the scope-confirmation sign-off

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit
System Touchpoints: - Project/design (links to VS-11 / W58 corporate account, VS-66 / W211 design)
- ESG/sustainability (links to VS-25 / W114 ESG reporting, W2619 corporate ESG rollup)
- Logistics/DC (links to VS-04 / W3 receiving, VS-04 / W52 fleet, VS-77 / material staging)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Green-Certified Sales Associate role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: Green-Certified Associate conducts consultation: project type, green target (BERDE/LEED or general sustainability), budget, timeline; identifies contributing BuildRight products
Associate develops recommendation: lower-impact alternatives, energy/water savings calculations, payback periods, BERDE/LEED credit mapping for recommended products

Associate creates quotation with green line-up, environmental benefit summary (energy saved, water saved, carbon reduced), BERDE/LEED scorecard; escalates to Coordinator for advanced support if needed

- ESG/sustainability (links to VS-25 / W114 ESG reporting, W2619 corporate ESG rollup)
- Analytics/BI (links to VS-27 / W113)

steps.activity: Department Supervisor identifies interest: high electricity bill, renovation, solar inquiry; offers free basic energy audit referral; explains partner auditor service
Sustainability Coordinator dispatches auditor: licensed auditor visits home, assesses consumption, recommends BuildRight products (LED, inverter AC, solar, insulation)
Sales Associate follows up: presents recommendations with savings calculations and payback, offers bundled pricing, coordinates delivery/installation; tracks conversion rate

steps.activity: Customer Service processes returns per policy; additionally assesses recyclability: LED → recycling partner, paint → hazwaste vendor, fixtures → manufacturer take-back
Sustainability Coordinator organizes quarterly events: collection of old fixtures, lighting, electronics for recycling; LGU partnership; loyalty points incentive
Coordinator reports end-of-life metrics: return rate (green vs. conventional), recycling rate, event participation; identifies product design and take-back improvements

steps.activity: Sustainability Coordinator compiles scorecard: certifications, carbon disclosure, sustainable sourcing, packaging waste, ethical labor, end-of-life program; 100-point scale
Procurement incorporates: minimum 70/100 for Green Choice suppliers, preferred status for top scorers, development plans for below-threshold; includes in vendor reviews
Category Manager identifies opportunities: high sustainability + poor availability (increase), low score + unique product (improve or replace), excellent sustainability story (co-marketing)
